title: Natural Domain and Graph of a Linear Function
originalTopic: Functions and Graphs: Domain and Graphing
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the natural domain and describe the graph of the linear function f(x) = 5 - 2x.

steps.title: Determine the Natural Domain
steps.explanation: The formula f(x) = 5 - 2x is a first-degree polynomial with no denominators or radicals, so it is defined for all real numbers x.
steps.why: Linear polynomials are well-defined on the entire real number line.

steps.title: Find the Axes Intercepts
steps.explanation: Evaluating at x = 0 gives the y-intercept (0, 5). Setting f(x) = 0 gives 2x = 5, so the x-intercept is (5/2, 0).
steps.why: Two distinct points uniquely determine the graph of a straight line.

steps.title: Characterize the Graph
steps.explanation: The graph is a straight line with slope m = -2 passing through (0, 5) and (2.5, 0), falling 2 units vertically for every 1 unit of horizontal run to the right.
steps.why: In slope-intercept form y = mx + b, m represents the constant rate of change and b is the y-intercept.
